name: universal-research-memory
description: Provenance-first research memory: hash-bound evidence fetch and a fail-closed eligibility gate over an append-only ledger.
long_description: Search returns candidates, never evidence. Before a material claim is released, the server re-reads the exact registered source range and checks its current SHA-256 revision; claims that silently omit evidence the session fetched and saw fail integrity are blocked. Safety properties are benchmarked, not assumed: https://github.com/mp-juns/universal-research-mcp#benchmarks

research_root.title: Research memory folder
research_root.description: The folder holding (or that will hold) your research store. On first run an empty folder is initialized automatically; add documents any time with 'universal-research quickstart <folder> --yes'.
